description: Metadata for public Georgia Tech Machine Learning Center HTML pages on ml.gatech.edu. www.ml.gatech.edu resolves, but its certificate does not match that host, so it contributes no rows. robots.txt is plain text and allows these paths. Each row is one bounded robots-allowed HTML GET on ml.gatech.edu. Challenges, HTML robots, login walls, non-HTML, robots disallows, and off-host redirects are omitted. Other Georgia Tech hosts are not fetched. Rows are title, publisher, canonical URL, publication date, and rights. Page text and PDFs are not stored. creative_commons_attribution is CC BY alone. creative_commons is CC0, CC BY-SA, or a permissive mix. Missing dates are unknown. Updated, modified, and copyright years are not publication dates. Not a belief collector. runner_wired is false.
